body_es: Las cadenas en Python son inmutables y ofrecen métodos como split(), join(), strip(), replace(), find().
body_en: Python strings are immutable and offer methods like split(), join(), strip(), replace(), find().
example_code:
text = '  Hello, World!  '
print(text.strip())
print(text.strip().split(', '))
print('-'.join(['a','b','c']))
